topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: Good morrow to thee who found these flowers at thy door. 'Tis a rare and wondrous thing, a gift from the unseen, much like the spring that whispers softly to the earth, bidding it wake. These petals, so brightly colored, they speak of days longer and light warmer. Mayhap it was a neighbor feeling the joy of the season, or perhaps the Virgin herself, noticing thy toil and care, deemed thee worthy of such a token. Such gifts, unspeaking of the giver, are a balm to the heart, a reminder that even in the midst of labor and worry, beauty finds its way to us. Keep them close, and let them remind thee that even in the poorest soil, the loveliest blooms can still find root and rise.
